knownExclusions: This source is limited to Idaho State Plumbing Board records and does not represent contractor registration, electrical, HVAC, public works, asbestos, local permits, or business-registration records.

researchNotes: Keep this source separate from DOPL contractor registration because plumbing contractor and specialty credentials are regulated through a distinct DOPL board.
